options.summary: Read journal files from a directory
options.detail: Search the supplied journal directory in place of the usual runtime and persistent paths. Short spelling of --directory=.

Bare -b selects the current boot, or the newest recorded boot with --directory=. Use -b -1 for the previous boot, -b 1 for the first, or -b all to clear the filter. Ubuntu 24.04 ignores the offset in ID+offset. Short spelling of --boot=.
options.summary: Select a boot by ID or offset

options.detail: Bare -n selects 10 entries. Use -n20 or -n 20 for the latest 20, +N for the oldest N, or all for all entries. Use 0 with --follow for new entries only. +N conflicts with --follow or --reverse. Short spelling of --lines=.
options.summary: Limit how many journal entries to show
